name: vinted_pro-mcp
description: Vinted Pro (ecommerce channels): me, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

platform_mcp_vinted_pro_access_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VINTED_PRO_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_vinted_pro_access_key.description: Access key: the part BEFORE the comma of the access token generated in the Vinted Pro Integrations Portal (tokens are shown only once; production and dev mode have separate tokens); sent as X-Vpi-Access-Key.

platform_mcp_vinted_pro_signing_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VINTED_PRO_SIGNING_KEY
platform_mcp_vinted_pro_signing_key.description: Signing key: the part AFTER the comma of the same access token. Signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over '<unix seconds>.<METHOD>.<path+query>.<access key>.<body>', sent as X-Vpi-Hmac-Sha256: t=<ts>,v1=<hash>); never sent on the wire.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one item created through the integration ({items[]}) to verify the access key and signature.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: DeleteItems DELETE /api/v1/items {item_ids: [uuid]} DELETES the item from Vinted asynchronously (202); `listing_id` is the VPI item_id (uuid). raw.accepted is false (with a reason) when the item cannot be deleted, e.g. still IN_PROGRESS.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GetOrders returns {orders: [{id, status, created_at}]} (status CREATED|READY_TO_BE_SHIPPED|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|LOST|RETURN_*|...). Paging is by the after-id cursor, and there are no status/date filters, so `status`, `since` and page numbers are not applied; amounts and items are in GetOrder.
